title: This Alluring Dark Elf Has the Heart of a Middle-Aged Man!
titleRomaji: Watashi no Kokoro wa Ojisan de Aru
titleEnglish: This Alluring Dark Elf Has the Heart of a Middle-Aged Man!
titleNative: 私の心はおじさんである
synonyms: My Heart Is an Old Man
synopsis: With no friends, family, or romance to speak of, Haruka has lived his life just going through the motions—until the day he awakens in the body of a beautiful, and womanly, dark elf! Suddenly, a world beyond his wildest imagination awaits, and uncontainable excitement races through him. There's just one problem: He gave up on putting himself out there a long time ago and has no idea how to strike up a conversation with other people. Teenagers and (other) women are certainly no exception. But with a bottomless well of mana and a ridiculously tough body to boot, Haruka won't let any overthinking get in the way this time. Little by little, the dark elf works past his (her) fears and self-doubt, forging deep bonds with precious new friends and growing together with them. So begins a heartwarming story of an old man determined to make the most of this new fantastical lease on life! (Source: J-Novel Club)

After their allies violently attack, chieftain Dineru of the dark elves commands her remaining people to flee, leading them into Orcsen, a land of orcs. Despite being enemies, Dineru and her clan are welcomed into the kingdom. Dineru makes a deal with the orc king, Gustav, asking for supplies so she can return to fight, but Gustav has other plans. Fighting alongside the dark elves, Gustav helps lead Dineru to victory and offers them a permanent home in the kingdom. Will Dineru and her people find peace, or is this the beginning of a deadly future? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Suki Darake desu, Leader-san!
titleNative: スキだらけです、リーダーさん！
synopsis: Urasaburo Fujiyoshi is a brilliant spy who has traveled all over the world. But now he has been targetted by the legendary assassin "RED", so he is hiding out as a part-time manager at a convenience store in rural Hokkaido until the situation cools down. However, the high school girl working at the convenience store, Akiko Karakohi, keeps asking Fujiyoshi about his past. Fujiyoshi suspects that she might be the assassin "RED" who is after him...? A life-threatening romantic comedy begins! (Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)
